items.text: Full toss and too full, too wide! Rutherford just reaches out and slashes at this, good enough to get the thick edge on this and for the ball to fly out towards deep third
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Rutherford, FOUR

items.text: Now speared into the blockhole like he intended last delivery as well... Glides this late out towards deep third
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Rutherford, 1 run

items.preText: Pal: "@Darshil: How can you forget Jayasurya, Chandrapaul, Andy flower, Amla, Ponting, Steve Smith"
items.text: A very loooooow full toss, basically a yorker, he flicks this out towards deep midwicket and somehow gets to the other end
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Hope, 1 run

items.text: Mayank Yadav with his last over, and it doesn't really bring a change of fortune for him! Back of length at the stumps, Shai Hope bends into an arch and lofts this over deep midwicket
Now he hits into the other side of the V! Was slot just outside off, he sends it down to long-off but the ball gets cut off
Rutherford, what a shot! Was on a length and rising at his hips, he muscles this so immensely over the deep midwicket boundary. Cinema

items.preText: Arquam: "I'm expecting Iyer to commit the blunder of giving penultimate or last over to Dhir despite having Reddy"
items.text: Almost holes out but he will live on! WAs in the slot, quiiiite full just outside off. He inside-out drives this, Naman Dhir at long-off decides to put in a big dive to try and cut this off... But ball bounces just short of him. And with that, WI bring up their 200 with so much cricket left to play...
Back of a length and aimed at his ribs, he shovels Mayank Yadav over the deep midwicket boundary this time! Swivels in his crease

Wow, those muscles! And even better is Naman Dhir! Let me put it chronologically: a yorker-ish ball at the stumps is short-arm jabbed down the ground, like a drive really. And Naman Dhir puts in a dive right down the ground to protect this from going to the boundary... Peak athletics all around
In the blockhole, he looks to glide this late but ball flies past his open-face bat
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Rutherford, no run

items.text: Arshdeep goes for a wide yorker but goes too full and too wide, outside the tramline, time to reload
Action replay except he nails the delivery this time! Pitch-perfect yorker just on the wide marker
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Rutherford, no run

items.text: Now he errs on the wrong side of the wide line again... Was going for another yorker

Low full toss and he's shovelled this down the ground, what a shot! Slipped out of Arshdeep's hands a tad bit early, tailing into the stumps and he stays still and simply rockets this over the bowler's head
Now he looks to drill this out of the blockhole once more, ball - on the bounce - goes back to the keeper
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Rutherford, no run

items.text: Well then, another wide on the marker outside off to the left-hander...

He lands this inside the wide marker, he plays a crisp high-elbowed drive out towards deep extra cover... Closed off with a great dive by the fielder there except ball goes under him after touching him, closed off finally near the ropes then

In the blockhole quite wide outside off... He bunts this back into the turf looking to guide it along the ground once more. Tactically bowled quite wide and in the final ledger, you can say it paid off considering the conditions...
items.shortText: Arshdeep Singh to Rutherford, no run

items.text: Misses out on the overthrow! Rapid and just outside off, he plays this out towards extra cover... Who has a great throw in but misses it, was probably looking at only one stump
Fired into the blockhole, flicked out towards deep midwicket
He has helicopter-flicked this out towards deep midwicket! Was kind of in the slot at the stumps, in fact at the stumps, and he shovels this away
Back of a length and he goes down on one knee and he bunts this out towards deep extra cover

Mayank Yadav has shelled this one, tbh! Was length outside off, Rutherford goes for a huge pull, a top-edge flies out towards fine leg, where Mayank really should have reached this one, but he doesn't
Played out towards long-on, was quite full
items.postText: Gautam Gambhir looking rather poker-faced at the moment from the dugout

items.preText: NKR bowling the 20th with only four outside the circle because of over-rate troubles.
items.text: Rutherford has shovelled this out towards cow corner! India hurting sorely with one fielder in. Was a low full toss on fifth stump and Rutherford has pulled this across the line
items.postText: It's Gautam Gambhir's birthday today, but he isn't the solution to WORD PLAY. Find the seven-letter word as fast as you can.
items.shortText: Nitish Kumar Reddy to Rutherford, FOUR
